rules.value: Normalize CRLF and lone CR to LF; setting even an unchanged value sets the dirty flag. Changed values move the cached caret to the end.
rules.defaultValue: Concatenate direct text children; comments and nested element text do not contribute. ChildrenChanged updates nondirty value and clamps cached endpoints.
rules.reflection: readOnly, disabled and required use attribute presence and native boolean conversion; textLength counts UTF-16 code units.
rules.conversion: Actual source conversion callbacks and receiver checks; direct null value becomes empty text, while object conversion returning null becomes the string null.
rules.domMutation: Native value dependencies update on parsed-tree construction, textContent/innerHTML, insertion/removal and direct text-node changes.
rules.export: Native ExportSave supplies its current serialization as parsed readonly textarea content, then invokes focus and select. No direct save oracle is added.
